approval.rationale: A dense mat of dry autumn grass at the right blade scale with no discrete features (no holes, leaves or clover) to repeat; the earlier candidates failed on those (41101, 41102).
limitations: The candidate had a straw-gold rim and a greyer centre; the cook evens the low-frequency tint (cook.evenChroma) and the variance-preserving wrap blend keeps detail across the seam, but a faint 4 m repeat of golden patches is still visible on large flat meadows from the 40 m camera.
Flat albedo: no grass geometry or cards.
